full_prompt_en: A square print-like landscape shows a shadowed street opening toward a pale, hazy waterfront beneath a warm cream sky. A large dark wooden building occupies the left third of the selected panel, its steep roof and projecting eaves cutting irregular angles into the sky. Dark vertical boards and a recessed doorway remain visible in the wall despite the heavy shadow. Another dark building mass presses in from the right edge, leaving a bright central gap that narrows toward a low horizon. The ground across the lower quarter is almost black, with rough grain and a gentle slope down toward the distant opening. Near the left side of that opening are two tiny human silhouettes: one lower and bent near the building, the other upright just to the right. Farther away, faint horizontal marks suggest a flat shore and thin distant structures without clear detail. Several narrow overhead lines stretch diagonally from high in the frame toward the right, crossing the lightly mottled sky. One small bird is visible near the center-right, with a second tiny dark mark nearby. The light comes from the open distance ahead, turning the sky pale yellow-cream and leaving the flanking buildings and foreground in deep brown-black silhouette. Fine paper-like grain, soft atmospheric fading, and firm roof edges coexist across the surface. The overall composition uses the bright central opening between heavy dark masses to create a quiet sense of distance and stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形版画式风景呈现一条幽暗街道，通向温暖乳白色天空下浅淡朦胧的水岸。所选单图左侧三分之一由一栋深色木建筑占据，陡斜屋顶和突出的屋檐在天空中切出参差的角度。虽然阴影沉重，墙上的竖向木板与内凹门口仍可辨认。另一块深色建筑形体从右缘挤入，只留下中央明亮的空隙，并向低平地平线收窄。下部四分之一的地面几乎全黑，带有粗颗粒，轻微向远处开口倾斜。开口左侧附近有两名极小的人影：一人在建筑旁位置较低、身体弯曲，另一人站在稍靠右处。更远方，微弱的水平笔痕暗示平坦岸线和细小的远处结构，但没有清楚细节。数条细窄的高空线条从画面上部斜伸向右，穿过轻微斑驳的天空。中央偏右可见一只小鸟，附近还有第二处极小深色痕迹。光从前方开阔的远处而来，使天空呈浅黄乳白色，让两侧建筑与前景沉入深棕黑剪影。细微的纸面颗粒、柔和的空气感淡化和明确的屋顶边缘在画面上共存。整体构图借沉重暗色体块之间明亮的中央开口，营造安静的距离感与静止感。
style_prompt_en: Print-like pictorial treatment combines fine paper grain with restrained, layered tonal areas. Deep brown-black silhouettes form heavy framing masses around an open cream and pale ocher center. Strong roof-like diagonals and long hairline marks cross the empty light field, while smaller irregular edges soften the otherwise severe geometry. Foreground darks are nearly solid but retain faint vertical and speckled texture; distant forms fade into warm haze through reduced contrast. Illumination is strongly backlit, with the brightest area held low and central rather than spread evenly across every surface. Very small dark accents in the open field reinforce scale and spaciousness. The composition relies on asymmetrical flanking weight, broad negative space, and a narrow horizon. The overall effect is quiet, atmospheric, and slightly aged.
style_prompt_zh: 版画式画面处理把细微纸纹与克制的层叠明暗区域结合起来。深棕黑剪影形成沉重的边框色块，围住乳白与浅赭色的开放中心。强烈的斜向结构与细长线痕穿过明亮留空，小小的不规则边缘则让原本严厉的几何形态稍显柔和。前景暗部近乎实心，却保留微弱的纵向和点状肌理；远处形体则因对比减弱而融入暖色薄雾。照明具有强烈逆光感，最亮处集中在下方中央，没有平均撒到所有表面。开放区域里极小的深色重音加强尺度与空旷感。构图依靠不对称的两侧重量、宽阔负空间和狭窄地平线。整体效果安静、富有空气感，并略显陈旧。
theme_en: Two small figures on a shadowed street opening toward a pale waterfront
theme_zh: 两个人影站在通向浅色水岸的幽暗街道上
name: Shin hanga
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
